name: agentgate
description: AgentGate — A firewall for AI agents. MCP security/governance middleware with a policy engine and human-in-the-loop dashboard.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n proxy,dashboard -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @agentgate/proxy" "npm run dev -w @agentgate/dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @agentgate/proxy && npm run build -w @agentgate/dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @agentgate/proxy && npm run typecheck -w @agentgate/dashboard
